name: Credit Score Estimator API
shortDescription: Transparent credit-score estimate from the public FICO category weights — score band + per-factor breakdown + improvement plan
description: Agent-native credit-score estimator computed from the publicly documented FICO category weights (payment history 35%, utilization 30%, length 15%, mix 10%, new credit 10%) and mapped to the 300–850 scale. /estimate returns an estimated score, an uncertainty band (±20), a rating, and a per-factor breakdown with each factor's sub-score and impact. The one-call /lookup adds a prioritized improvement plan, reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and assumptions. A deterministic MODEL and explicit estimate — not your actual FICO/VantageScore — so confidence is intentionally below 1.0. No fabrication: every sub-score derives from your inputs. Estimate only — NOT a credit decision; not for credit underwriting, adverse-action notices, or any FCRA-regulated purpose.
